definitions: A powerful muscle in the face that connects the mandible (lower jaw) to the cheekbone (zygomatic arch) and is primarily responsible for the action of chewing.
One of the four muscles of mastication, located on the side of the head.
examples: The masseter muscle is crucial for biting and grinding food.
Pain in the masseter muscle can be a symptom of temporomandibular joint dysfunction.
During a dental examination, the dentist palpated the masseter muscle.
